It also appears that [OLM is deprecated](https://gitlab.matrix.org/matrix-org/olm#important-libolm-is-now-deprecated) in favor of a newer Rust version, [vodozemac](https://github.com/matrix-org/vodozemac).

Editing to add that I'm using `Python 3.14.3` in my environment.

I solved the issue as below:
1 install the Microsoft vc++ build tools
2download python-olm 3.2.16 source code from https://pypi.org/project/python-olm/3.2.16/#files
3 open "x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS" with administrator's right
4 active Hermes venv
5 cd \path\to\python-olm-source-code
6 pip install .
7 pip install "hermes-agent[matrix]"

before 6th step, I edit  olm_build.py like this

[olm_build.py](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30274231/olm_build.py)
